overview.en: This catalogue retains the name Pseudotropheus socolofi, now generally accepted as Chindongo socolofi. The cichlid is recorded along the Mozambican shore of Lake Malawi.
overview.fr: Ce catalogue conserve le nom Pseudotropheus socolofi, aujourd’hui généralement accepté comme Chindongo socolofi. Ce cichlidé est signalé sur la rive mozambicaine du lac Malawi.

identification.en: The name Pindani is used for this species.
identification.fr: Le nom Pindani est utilisé pour cette espèce.

habitat.en: It inhabits shallow water over sand, with territorial males remaining near rocks.
habitat.fr: Il fréquente les eaux peu profondes au-dessus de fonds sableux, les mâles territoriaux restant près des rochers.

diet.en: It feeds on the biocover growing on rock and sand.
diet.fr: Il se nourrit du biofilm qui couvre les rochers et le sable.

behavior.en: Territorial males stay close to rocks.
behavior.fr: Les mâles territoriaux restent près des rochers.

reproduction.en: Females incubate eggs in their mouths.
reproduction.fr: Les femelles incubent les œufs dans leur bouche.

ecology.en: Its distribution in Lake Malawi is limited to Mozambique in the FishBase record.
ecology.fr: Dans la fiche FishBase, sa répartition au lac Malawi se limite au Mozambique.

conservation.en: FishBase reports a global IUCN assessment of Least Concern from 2018.
conservation.fr: FishBase rapporte une évaluation mondiale UICN « Préoccupation mineure » datant de 2018.

facts: FishBase lists the Mozambique range, Pindani name, sandy shallows, biofilm diet, mouthbrooding and 2018 IUCN category.

uncertainties: The catalogue retains the supplied Pseudotropheus name as its ID/scientific label, while contemporary taxonomic databases use Chindongo socolofi. No color diagnosis is added because the consulted database summary does not supply one.
review_note: Taxonomy was checked against the California Academy of Sciences and a French-language reference; biological details are limited to FishBase records.
